fields.acceptance: tui-requests-app.txtar: --once lists the requests as JSON matching request ls; unit tests on a fake runner file a bug (kind bug) and a feature from typed text and show the new request queued; rex-install.txtar shows the rhiza_app_requests action on a free key and no existing key moved
fields.statement: A Rex app, requests, files a feature, bug or milestone request from typed text and lists every request with its state, run and planned change set, focusing a planning run's tab on enter
